import 'dart:async';

// test_api's live test is the boundary; the global_state getters and the binding's completion
// arguments below are the actual patched Patrol source.
enum Result {
  success,
  skipped,
  failure,
  error;

  bool get isPassing => this == success || this == skipped;
}

class State {
  State(this.result);
  final Result result;
}

enum MessageType { print, skip }

class Message {
  Message(this.type, this.text);
  final MessageType type;
  final String text;
}

class AsyncError {
  AsyncError(this.error, [this.stackTrace = StackTrace.empty]);
  final Object error;
  final StackTrace stackTrace;
}

/// flutter_test records a widget test's failure as one of these; its toString() names only the type.
class FlutterErrorDetails {
  FlutterErrorDetails({required this.exception, this.stack});
  final Object exception;
  final StackTrace? stack;
  String exceptionAsString() => '$exception';
}

class LiveTest {
  var state = State(Result.success);
  final errors = <AsyncError>[];
  final _messages = StreamController<Message>.broadcast(sync: true);
  Stream<Message> get onMessage => _messages.stream;

  void skip(String reason) {
    _messages.add(Message(MessageType.skip, reason));
    state = State(Result.skipped);
  }

  void fail(Object error, [StackTrace stackTrace = StackTrace.empty]) {
    errors.add(AsyncError(error, stackTrace));
    state = State(Result.error);
  }
}

class Invoker {
  static Invoker? current;
  final liveTest = LiveTest();
}

class Failure {
  Failure(this.details);
  final String? details;
}

bool get isCurrentTestPassing => Invoker.current!.liveTest.state.result.isPassing;

// ACTUAL_GLOBAL_STATE

final _testResults = <String, Object>{};
const String? _currentDartTest = 'journey';

String _report() {
  final passed = isCurrentTestPassing;
  final sent = (
// ACTUAL_COMPLETION_ARGUMENTS
  );
  return 'passed=${sent.passed} skipped=${sent.skipped} details=${sent.details}';
}

String _scenario(void Function(LiveTest test) steps) {
  Invoker.current = Invoker();
  _testResults.clear();
  watchCurrentTestSkipReason();
  steps(Invoker.current!.liveTest);
  return _report();
}

void main() {
  print(_scenario((_) {}));
  print(_scenario((test) => test.skip('TEST_DATA_X needs another user')));
  print(_scenario((test) => test
    ..skip('TEST_DATA_X needs another user')
    ..fail(StateError('late app error\nstack line'))));
  print(_scenario((test) {
    test.skip('TEST_DATA_X needs another user');
    _testResults['journey'] = Failure('pending FlutterError');
  }));
  print(_scenario((test) => test
    ..fail('boom')
    ..skip('TEST_DATA_X needs another user')));
  print(_scenario((test) => test.fail('boom')));
  print(_scenario((test) {
    test.fail('boom');
    _testResults['journey'] = Failure('Expected: true');
  }));
  print(_scenario((test) => test.fail(FlutterErrorDetails(
      exception: 'Expected: true\n  Actual: <false>\nlogin page chain: AUTHERR:ChallengeStatus_LockedOut',
      stack: StackTrace.fromString('#0      fail (expect.dart:187)\n#1      _expect (expect.dart:182)\n\n#2      x')))));
  print(_scenario((test) => test.fail(StateError('late'), StackTrace.fromString('#0      main (main.dart:1)'))));
}
